A fountain in the middle of a large open square between two sides with large buildings. Some people and lamps can be seen nearby.

A wooden basked of six individual cartons of strawberries.
A street with dedicated walking lanes on either side of a designated bikeway.

A small two story orange building with green accents sits in the foreground. In the background to the right of the focal point is a large, multi-story apartment building, and to the left of the focal point is a small building and a tree.
This looks like an old building located in an old city.
A View of the front of a white building with many windows that is in the shape of an arch. The windows are facing the camera and also the lawn area with a lot of green trees and grass in it
The ruins of a stone structures sits among a desert landscape.
A 45 cent stamp with a photo of a red flower on it.
The platform of an underground train station.
A warehouse worker with pallet jack examines boxes on a shelf.

A half sun-lit outdoor courtyard with seating, plants, and lights.
A group of young men and women are on the curb outside of a large yellow building. There is a blue sign with white letters in the foreground and a number of palm trees in the background.

A person is using an oar to raft down river rapids in an orange, inflatable boat. The river is along side a bank that has dead branches, a sandy area with many stones, and a wooded area in the background.
A view of the ocean with a number of smaller boats near the shore and much larger ships further away. There is a small island covered with trees to the left.

An assortment of scarves is lying on a table, probably for sale but maybe just for sheer presentation. The scarves come in a wide variety of colors, but they all bear some sort of insignia, as if for a club or team or something. There is a snippet of walkway in front of the table. All the scarves are arranged side by side, and are hanging over the front edge of the table, and ending just above the ground below.
People and cars are on the street along a city area. There are buildings along the sidewalk and a large tree.

The mouth of a teal waterslide, emptying into a pool, flanked by palm trees and other green vegetation.  A stream of water is coming down the slide and two males in a teal inner tube are coming down the slide.
There is a Red Tram driving through a bussling city. There are people all around and colorful banners overhead. The weather is warm and dry and very clear.
A statue stands in the middle of a plaza with pillars flanking it. Flowers are visible in the foreground, while trees and buildings can be seen in the background.
A white quaint European row house row house.

This is a white and gray strip mall. Most on the exterior is white, and most of the trim is gray. It includes the stores Douglas, Neimann, and Werre Park. The parking lot is empty except for a silver van and a red car. It looks like it's before opening time. The parking lot has many streetlights. The parking spaces are beige brick while center of each lane is gray concrete.

A clear translucent whiskey bottle with a white label that has an outline of a brown leaf and stem. The lettering is black. The top of the bottle has a wooden cork and a black seal around the top. The bottle is standing upright on a dark brown wicker circle mat.

A blue and white wooden fishing boat is docked and tied to a pier on a sunny, cloudless day. There is a small bay of water behind the boat and other boats and medium-sized buildings across the small bay. In front of the boat are multicolored rectangular flat concrete slabs.
A red phone booth is centrally located on a street with many shops and pedestrians walking and browsing.
This is a large mansion, which is three stories. It seems weathered and has a staircase leading up to it and a gray sky in the background.
A statue is positioned within a fountain against a blue sky with a few very wispy clouds. The scene is upon a hill, with the hill's edge being rimmed by evenly spaced trees.
Several stone buildings are visible beneath a pure blue sky during midday. The central building has multiple castle-style spires.
There is a large white castle with many windows. In front of the castle is a well kept garden with green, white and red, flowers and a paved road is around the garden.
A outdoors market selling plants. There are flowers, wreaths, baskets, and more, all arranged in rows and steps.

Five white and grey horses are standing in a grassy park with trees and a white and green building in the background.   A man walks past them holding a broom and piece of red wood, and other people look at the animals from a sidewalk, behind a small fence.

A set of railroad tracks on the right of the image beside of a dark brown and red brick retaining wall. There's an asphalt blacktop road with a yellow line and a fence to the left of it and surrounded by trees on both sides.
A large castle that has green trees in the background. There seems to be parts of a city below the castle.
A soccer player is preparing to kick a soccer ball. He is on a grass field and there are stands behind him filled with people.
A bedroom, likely for a child, with a bed on one side of the room, a desk and chair set across from the bed, and with a window covered by lace curtains.
An old European village having a march in solidarity with Ukraine. The procession is carrying a large yellow and blue flag of Ukraine as they pass through the streets between buildings.
A large group of people are gathered for a ceremony. There are a couple people dressed in old attire holding flags.
A basket lift used in construction is suspended in the air. There is someone in the basket preparing to perform work.

An industrial crane at a dock.

The upper part of a partially filled glass of iced tea or other translucent, light brown beverage, in front of a blank wall.  There's condensation on the glass, a lemon slice on the lip of the glass, and ice and beverage in the glass.

A yellow and black gas pump nozzle sticking in the gas tank on the right side of a dark four-door car.  The ground is pavement and in the background appears to be a brown brick wall with a grey sign on it.

A Ferris wheel and amusement park set up in a green field and park, seen from the sky.  There's a parking lot filled with cars next to the park, two bodies of water flanking it, and trees and a community in the background.

A black man reaches his left hand into a large light-blue cylindrical container. Surrounding him are three identical containers two behind, and one in front. The front container has the end of a water hose lying in it. Surrounding the man and the containers is heavy vegetation. Directly behind the man is a tall man-made post, suggesting the man is under a roof of some sort.
